_README: Visible Human male: outer boundary of his segmented lower-limb muscles (DU release) per 10 mm level and 36 directions about the femur (above the knee) / tibia centre; atlas mm. Source side of the cross-subject transfer (scripts/transfer/lean_envelope.py).
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), male and female CT and cryosections via the NCI Imaging Data Commons; lower-limb geometry Andreassen et al. 2023, Sci Data 10:34, doi:10.1038/s41597-022-01905-2 (CC BY 4.0). Derived data (scripts/transfer/lean_envelope.py).
